capabilities.description: Pure mathematical sell-versus-hold calculation on explicit user/research parameters.
capabilities.gating_rule: Requires explicit parameters. Returns conditional arithmetic only.

capabilities.description: Monotonic transformation of prediction interval bounds [lower, upper] to holding benefit bounds.
capabilities.gating_rule: Bounds represent conditional range under fixed costs, NOT profitability probability.
Hard blocked: commercial cost profiles unverified, recent interval coverage undercovered (72-76%), no prospective randomized trial.

capabilities.description: Empirical backtest of policy win rates / economic uplift on historical predictions archive.
capabilities.gating_rule: Requires verified commercial tariff feed. No synthetic operational feed generation without owner proposal & approval.
